confirmation_mode.description: shadow: a person approves every order. auto_simple: clean orders with nothing flagged go through on their own; everything else still waits for a person.
confirmation_mode.title: How orders are confirmed

cutoff_time.description: Orders that arrive after this time for delivery the next day are flagged. Write it as 24-hour time, for example 14:00. Leave it empty to use only each customer's own cut-off. A customer's own cut-off always wins.
cutoff_time.title: Order cut-off time

delivery_days.description: An order asking for delivery on any other day is flagged for a person.
delivery_days.title: Days you deliver

duplicate_window_days.description: Flag an order when the same customer sent the same PO number within this many days. 0 turns the check off.
duplicate_window_days.title: Duplicate order check (days)

guessed_products.description: always_ask: a person checks every line Order Desk had to guess. accept_single: accept the guess when only one product fits the name.
guessed_products.title: When a product is a best guess

missing_po.description: customer_rule: only hold the order for customers marked as needing a PO. always_ask: hold every order without a PO and ask.
missing_po.title: When an order has no PO number

missing_unit.description: ask: a person checks the line. selling_unit: assume the product's selling unit.
missing_unit.title: When a line has no unit

substitutions.description: never: never swap one product for another. customer_rules: only when that customer's notes or rules allow it.
substitutions.title: Substitutions

time_zone.description: Used to work out whether an order arrived before the cut-off.
time_zone.title: Your time zone

unusual_quantity_factor.description: Flag a line when the quantity is more than this many times what the customer usually orders of that product. 0 turns the check off.
unusual_quantity_factor.title: Unusual quantity check

description: What Order Desk needs before it can take orders: how orders are confirmed and checked, and who manages and reviews them.
name: Order Desk setup
